latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the news-digest skill — a user-driven, configurable news aggregation and push system.

- Aggregates news from Twitter (via Xpoz MCP), Hacker News, and Tavily Search, filtering by user-defined topics, keywords, and influence.
- Completely user-configurable schedule: users define push times, topics, labels, keywords, and priority rules via interactive setup.
- Summarizes and formats selected news items per user preferences, supporting custom language, summary length, and item count.
- Supports both manual and scheduled pushes, with local configuration management and feedback integration.
- All logic driven by user’s config.json — no hardcoded topics, times, or keywords used without consent.
